purpose: Post-primary replication of pair adjudication with a materially different requested model tier. No extraction is rerun and no source facts change.
acceptance: Report field-level agreement/source-grounding/material-contradiction results without changing the primary contract or selecting cases after seeing Pro outputs.
claimCeiling: A second provider model strengthens robustness against one-model judging but is still model-based evaluation, not independent human historical adjudication.
This replication cannot establish that MINIMAL_CAUSAL_DELTA is a universal schema or that every historical problem needs process lineage.
